task_completion.description: Open hbb_wildtype_amplicon.fasta and hbb_mutant_amplicon.fasta in UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE interface showing both FASTA files loaded in the Project View or as open sequence tabs.

task_completion.description: Perform a restriction digest using the DdeI enzyme on both sequences.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Restriction Analysis' or 'Find Restriction Sites' dialog open with 'DdeI' selected, or DdeI annotations appearing on the sequence maps.

task_completion.description: Export the annotated wild-type sequence as a GenBank file to the results folder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export as GenBank' dialog showing the path ~/UGENE_Data/rflp_genotyping/results/hbb_wildtype_ddei.gb.

task_completion.description: Export the annotated mutant sequence as a GenBank file to the results folder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export as GenBank' dialog showing the path ~/UGENE_Data/rflp_genotyping/results/hbb_mutant_ddei.gb.

task_completion.description: Identify the correct number of sites and fragment lengths for both alleles.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE 'Digest Sequence' results table or 'Annotations' list showing 2 sites (3 fragments) for WT and 1 site (2 fragments) for Mutant, with lengths matching 100, 97, 203 (WT) and 100, 300 (Mutant).

task_completion.description: Create the genotyping_report.txt with the required data and comparison.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing genotyping_report.txt containing the specific fragment lengths (100, 97, 203 vs 100, 300) and a concluding statement.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI for the restriction analysis rather than just command-line tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the UGENE application window, menus, and dialog boxes being interacted with.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply write the report without performing the analysis in UGENE.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequence of screenshots showing the analysis steps in UGENE occurring before the report is finalized.

integrity.description: The GenBank files were exported from within the UGENE interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UGENE 'Export' or 'Save' dialogs visible in the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Wild-type (WT) amplicon has 2 DdeI sites, resulting in 3 fragments of lengths 100, 97, and 203 bp. The Mutant amplicon has 1 DdeI site, resulting in 2 fragments of lengths 100 and 300 bp. The DdeI recognition site is CTNAG. The report must be saved at ~/UGENE_Data/rflp_genotyping/results/genotyping_report.txt and the GenBank files must be in the same results directory.
